sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Balbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: President Trump says that he is pausing some of the tariffs that took effect overnight.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统表示，他将暂停一些隔夜生效的关税。

sentences.en: He announced a 90-day pause on most of his new tariffs.
sentences.zh: 他宣布对大部分新关税实施90天的暂停期。

sentences.en: After promising that tariffs against dozens of countries were here to stay, no matter how much they hurt businesses or the stock market,
sentences.zh: 在承诺过无论对企业或股市造成多大伤害，针对数十个国家的关税都将持续下去之后，

sentences.en: President Trump has abruptly reversed course.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统突然改变了方针。

sentences.en: A universal 10% tariff is in place while country-specific deals come together and sector-specific tariffs remain.
sentences.zh: 在各国达成具体协议的同时，普遍的10%关税依然有效，针对特定行业的关税也予以保留。

sentences.en: It looks like the U.S.
sentences.zh: 看起来美国

sentences.en: has blinked.
sentences.zh: 退缩了。

sentences.en: Except when it comes to China.
sentences.zh: 除了针对中国的情况。

sentences.en: The president also saying that he will raise the tariff on Chinese imports now up to 125%.
sentences.zh: 总统还表示，他现在将把中国进口商品的关税提高到125%。

sentences.en: Today, Jonathan Swan on why the president changed his mind and David Pearson on why China won't back down.
sentences.zh: 今天，乔纳森·斯旺将讲述总统为何改变主意，大卫·皮尔逊将分析中国为何不会退让。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, April 10th.
sentences.zh: 今天是4月10日，星期四。

sentences.en: Hey, Jonathan.
sentences.zh: 嘿，乔纳森。

sentences.en: Thank you for coming in very last minute and joining us.
sentences.zh: 感谢你在最后一刻赶来加入我们。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请。

sentences.en: So the question here is very simple.
sentences.zh: 所以这里的问题很简单。

sentences.en: Why did Donald Trump reverse himself here and take the off-ramp from these tariffs that none of us thought he was very likely to take?
sentences.zh: 为什么唐纳德·特朗普会在这里反悔，并从这些我们认为他不太可能退出的关税政策中撤出？

sentences.en: What happened here?
sentences.zh: 这里发生了什么？

sentences.en: Well, if you listen to the public explanations from his aides...
sentences.zh: 嗯，如果你听听他助手们的公开解释……

sentences.en: This negotiation went exactly the way we had hoped it would go.
sentences.zh: 这次谈判完全按照我们预期的方向进行了。

sentences.en: This is...
sentences.zh: 这就是……

sentences.en: This was the plan all along.
sentences.zh: 这从一开始就是计划好的。

sentences.en: As I told everyone a week ago, do not retaliate and you will be rewarded.
sentences.zh: 正如我一周前告诉大家的，不要报复，你就会得到回报。

sentences.en: The Treasury Secretary, the Press Secretary...
sentences.zh: 财政部长、新闻秘书……

sentences.en: Many of you in the media clearly missed the art of the deal.
sentences.zh: 你们媒体中的许多人显然错过了交易的艺术。

sentences.en: You clearly failed to see what President Trump is doing here.
sentences.zh: 你们显然没能看出特朗普总统在这里所做的事情。

sentences.en: The genius out-of-the-deal strategy to isolate China and, you know, negotiate with the rest of the world.
sentences.zh: 这种孤立中国并与世界其他地区进行谈判的天才交易策略。

sentences.en: The entire world is calling the United States of America, not China, because they need our markets, they need our consumers, and they need this president in the Oval Office to talk
sentences.zh: 全世界都在给美利坚合众国打电话，而不是中国，因为他们需要我们的市场，需要我们的消费者，也需要这位总统在椭圆形办公室与他们对话。

sentences.en: to them.
sentences.zh: 对吧。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: This was all pre-planned.
sentences.zh: 这一切都是预先计划好的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: That's not true.
sentences.zh: 那不是真的。

sentences.en: Behind the scenes, what actually happened...
sentences.zh: 在幕后，实际发生的是……

sentences.en: And we're still getting more detail now.
sentences.zh: 而且我们现在还在获取更多细节。

sentences.en: You know, my colleagues, Maggie Haberman and myself and others on our team have been reporting this out, but...
sentences.zh: 你知道，我的同事玛吉·哈伯曼和我，还有我们团队的其他成员一直在报道这件事，但是……

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It's only five o'clock.
sentences.zh: 现在才五点钟。

sentences.en: We haven't had all that much time to make sense of basically a three-hour-old pause.
sentences.zh: 我们还没有太多时间去理清这个基本上才三个小时前宣布的暂停决定。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: But based on the conversations I've had in the last two hours, I can say with confidence that this was a decision driven by fear of a full-blown financial panic crisis.
sentences.zh: 但根据我过去两个小时的谈话，我可以肯定地说，这是一个出于对全面金融恐慌危机的恐惧而驱动的决定。

sentences.en: It is true that Scott Besant, the Treasury Secretary, and others in Trump's orbit have been
sentences.zh: 确实，财政部长斯科特·贝森特以及特朗普圈子里的其他人

sentences.en: for several days now trying to talk him towards a more tailored tariff strategy, one that would
sentences.zh: 几天来一直试图劝说他采取更具针对性的关税策略，这种策略

sentences.en: not punish allies as harshly as America's worst trade adversaries, and one that would potentially
sentences.zh: 不会像对待美国最糟糕的贸易对手那样严厉地惩罚盟友，并且可能

sentences.en: isolate China while putting a freeze on other countries to negotiate, which is where they ended up.
sentences.zh: 在孤立中国的同时，冻结其他国家的关税以便进行谈判，这正是他们最终达成的结果。

sentences.en: But as has become clear in conversations I've had in the last couple of hours, the entity that deserves most credit for today's decision is the bond markets, and fear among Trump's
sentences.zh: 但正如我在过去几个小时的谈话中明确的那样，今天这个决定最应该归功于债券市场，以及特朗普团队内部

sentences.en: team that this could spiral out into a full-blown financial panic.
sentences.zh: 担心这可能会演变成一场全面的金融恐慌。

sentences.en: So just explain the meltdown, Jonathan, in the bond market.
sentences.zh: 那么，乔纳森，请解释一下债券市场的崩溃。

sentences.en: Well, you've got the worst person you could possibly ask to explain the meltdown in the bond market.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你找错人了，我是解释债券市场崩溃最不合适的人选。

sentences.en: You actually need someone who knows what they're talking about.
sentences.zh: 你其实需要一个真正懂行的人。

sentences.en: Okay, okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧，好吧。

sentences.en: Jonathan, we figured this might be the case, that you are not the authority on the bond market.
sentences.zh: 乔纳森，我们猜到会这样，你确实不是债券市场的权威。

sentences.en: And so in the grand tradition of phoning a friend and having Marshall McLuhan behind the
sentences.zh: 所以，秉承着打电话求助朋友的优良传统，让马歇尔·麦克卢汉躲在

sentences.en: potted plant, we're going to bring on someone who is an authority on bonds to briefly explain what the heck just happened there.
sentences.zh: 盆栽后面，我们要请一位债券方面的权威来简要解释一下刚才到底发生了什么。

sentences.en: I think that's very wise for your listeners.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这对你的听众来说非常明智。

sentences.en: Hey, Peter Goodman.
sentences.zh: 嘿，彼得·古德曼。

sentences.en: Michael Barbara.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: How are you, sir?
sentences.zh: 你好吗，先生？

sentences.en: Good, good.
sentences.zh: 很好，很好。

sentences.en: Also, hello to Jonathan Swan, who has just acknowledged what I would acknowledge in this moment, too, which is that the bond market is pretty hard to explain.
sentences.zh: 还有，向乔纳森·斯旺问好，他也刚刚承认了我在这一刻也会承认的事情，那就是债券市场确实很难解释。

sentences.en: So we decided to call you and ask you to just briefly explain what happened in the bond market, because as Jonathan just put it, that felt decisive in the Trump administration's
sentences.zh: 所以我们决定给你打电话，请你简要解释一下债券市场发生了什么，因为正如乔纳森刚才所说，这在特朗普政府

sentences.en: decision to hit pause on the tariffs.
sentences.zh: 决定暂停关税的决策中起到了决定性作用。

sentences.en: That terrified them, Jonathan just said.
sentences.zh: 乔纳森刚才说，这让他们感到恐惧。

sentences.en: So what happened?
sentences.zh: 那么发生了什么？

sentences.en: Why would it merit terror from this administration?
sentences.zh: 为什么这会让本届政府感到恐惧？

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: So there are not a lot of sure things in this world, but one of them is that in times of crisis, people around the world buy the U.S.
sentences.zh: 这个世界上没有多少确定的事情，但其中之一就是，在危机时期，世界各地的人们都会购买美元，

sentences.en: dollar, and specifically, they buy U.S.
sentences.zh: 特别是购买美国

sentences.en: government bonds.
sentences.zh: 政府债券。

sentences.en: Because there's this built-in assumption that whatever happens, war, aliens invade, you know, whatever, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 因为人们有一种内在的假设，无论发生什么，战争、外星人入侵，你知道，无论什么，美国

sentences.en: government's going to endure.
sentences.zh: 政府都会屹立不倒。

sentences.en: And that appears to have broken down, not fully, but at least in the margins, this idea that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 而这种假设似乎已经破灭了，虽然不是完全破灭，但至少在边缘地带，这种认为美国

sentences.en: is the ultimate safe haven is broken down.
sentences.zh: 是终极避风港的想法已经破灭了。

sentences.en: And when people are less willing to buy U.S.
sentences.zh: 当人们不太愿意购买美国

sentences.en: government debt, U.S.
sentences.zh: 政府债务时，美国

sentences.en: government has to pay a greater rate of return to persuade people to buy our debt.
sentences.zh: 政府就必须支付更高的回报率来劝说人们购买我们的债务。

sentences.en: They have to pay higher interest rates, basically.
sentences.zh: 基本上，他们必须支付更高的利率。

sentences.en: And a lot of other interest rates are paid to the rates on U.S.
sentences.zh: 而许多其他利率都是基于美国

sentences.en: government debt, mortgages, credit cards.
sentences.zh: 政府债务的利率，比如抵押贷款、信用卡。

sentences.en: And so you've got both the message of the bond market freaking out, which is that people who trade money for a living worry that bad days are ahead.
sentences.zh: 所以你既看到了债券市场恐慌所传达的信息，即那些以交易货币为生的人担心坏日子即将来临。

sentences.en: And then you've got the direct consequences of jacking up borrowing rates, which is an easy way to end up in a nasty suicide.
sentences.zh: 又看到了提高借贷利率的直接后果，这是一种很容易导致陷入严重困境的方式。

sentences.en: God, just to make sure I understand, traditionally, you buy a bond, you basically loan the United
sentences.zh: 天哪，为了确保我理解正确，传统上，你购买债券，基本上就是借给美国

sentences.en: States government some money.
sentences.zh: 政府一些钱。

sentences.en: You are a thousand percent sure that money is going to come back with a little extra.
sentences.zh: 你百分之千地确定这些钱会连本带利地回来。

sentences.en: All of a sudden, people are fearful that might not be the case.
sentences.zh: 突然之间，人们担心情况可能并非如此。

sentences.en: The government might not be so dependable.
sentences.zh: 政府可能不再那么可靠了。

sentences.en: They start selling these bonds, and it starts to mess up all other kinds of borrowing rates around the economy.
sentences.zh: 他们开始抛售这些债券，这开始扰乱经济中所有其他类型的借贷利率。

sentences.en: And that's how you suddenly get into a situation where this all starts to go really sideways.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么你突然陷入了一种局面，一切都开始变得非常糟糕。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, you know, your mortgage goes up, or you're going to spend less on other parts of the economy, which means you're depriving businesses of income.
sentences.zh: 是的，我的意思是，你知道，你的抵押贷款利率上升了，或者你会在经济的其他方面减少支出，这意味着你剥夺了企业的收入。

sentences.en: Maybe you're not going to buy that house you were thinking about, and now the housing prices don't go up as much, and some developer doesn't make as much money as they hoped.
sentences.zh: 也许你不会买你原本打算买的那套房子，现在房价涨幅没那么大了，有些开发商赚的钱也没他们希望的那么多。

sentences.en: And construction companies get less business as a result.
sentences.zh: 结果建筑公司得到的业务也少了。

sentences.en: This is how economic downturns happen.
sentences.zh: 这就是经济衰退发生的方式。

sentences.en: And one key trigger is when the cost of borrowing money goes up, and especially quickly, that can be a real shock to the system.
sentences.zh: 而一个关键的触发因素是借钱的成本上升，尤其是上升得很快时，这会对系统造成真正的冲击。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: And that shock is exactly what happened today in the bottom right.
sentences.zh: 而这种冲击正是今天在债券市场发生的事情。

sentences.en: Okay, Peter, this is really helpful.
sentences.zh: 好的，彼得，这真的很有帮助。

sentences.en: So thank you.
sentences.zh: 所以谢谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Jonathan, do you get it now?
sentences.zh: 乔纳森，你现在明白了吗？

sentences.en: I kind of got it before, but not in a way that was going to be very useful to your listeners.
sentences.zh: 我之前大概明白，但方式对你的听众来说不太有用。

sentences.en: I'm glad you got Peter on.
sentences.zh: 我很高兴你请来了彼得。

sentences.en: Well, perhaps you could have done it just as well.
sentences.zh: 嗯，也许你也能做得一样好。

sentences.en: We'll never know.
sentences.zh: 我们永远不会知道了。

sentences.en: No, no, no, no, no.
sentences.zh: 不，不，不，不，不。

sentences.en: You made the right decision.
sentences.zh: 你做了正确的决定。

sentences.en: So what else is factoring into the White House decision beyond the bond market?
sentences.zh: 那么除了债券市场之外，还有什么因素影响了白宫的决定？

sentences.en: When we had been talking to you a couple of days ago, there were all these CEOs knocking on the president's door and saying, this is not sustainable.
sentences.zh: 当我们几天前和你谈话时，有那么多首席执行官敲开总统的门说，这是不可持续的。

sentences.en: None of that mattered.
sentences.zh: 那些都没起作用。

sentences.en: It was just the bond market suddenly going haywire, or was it all kind of becoming one big collective, untenable situation?
sentences.zh: 仅仅是因为债券市场突然陷入混乱，还是这一切都变成了一种巨大的、集体性的、无法维持的局面？

sentences.en: Well, I don't want to pretend omniscience here.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我不想假装全知全能。

sentences.en: It's very hard to kind of get inside Trump's head.
sentences.zh: 要进入特朗普的头脑非常困难。

sentences.en: As I said to you in the last time we talked, the only thing you could really go by is what he's saying privately and what he's saying publicly.
sentences.zh: 正如我上次和你谈话时所说，你唯一能真正依据的就是他私下说的话和公开说的话。

sentences.en: And the two things were pretty much the same, which was these tariffs are great.
sentences.zh: 而这两者几乎是一样的，那就是这些关税太棒了。

sentences.en: They're bringing in money.
sentences.zh: 它们正在带来收入。

sentences.en: Everyone's coming and begging to me and kissing my ass.
sentences.zh: 每个人都来求我，拍我马屁。

sentences.en: But I think things pretty clearly started to shift Sunday night, Monday morning in the direction of being open to negotiations.
sentences.zh: 但我认为事情在周日晚上、周一早上非常明显地开始向愿意谈判的方向转变。

sentences.en: My colleague, Maggie Haberman, has some reporting that Scott Besant, the Treasury Secretary, flew
sentences.zh: 我的同事玛吉·哈伯曼有一些报道称，财政部长斯科特·贝森特周日晚上

sentences.en: with Trump to Washington from Palm Beach on Sunday night and had a really important conversation with him on the plane, steering him more in this direction.
sentences.zh: 和特朗普一起从棕榈滩飞往华盛顿，并在飞机上与他进行了一次非常重要的谈话，引导他更多地朝着这个方向发展。

sentences.en: J.D.
sentences.zh: J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, actually, the vice president, was supportive of this idea of being more structured with the tariffs, focusing more on China.
sentences.zh: 万斯，实际上，副总统，支持这种对关税采取更有条理、更多地关注中国的想法。

sentences.en: So these conversations were happening.
sentences.zh: 所以这些对话一直在进行。

sentences.en: But when we last spoke, which was Monday, I didn't have any sense.
sentences.zh: 但当我们上次交谈时，也就是周一，我没有任何感觉。

sentences.en: And neither, this is the more important part, neither did Trump's most senior advisors that he was going to back off these tariffs.
sentences.zh: 而且更重要的是，特朗普最高级的顾问们也没有感觉到他会放弃这些关税。

sentences.en: Mr. Trade Representative, are you aware that the tariffs have been paused?
sentences.zh: 贸易代表先生，你知道关税已经被暂停了吗？

sentences.en: I am, yes.
sentences.zh: 我知道，是的。

sentences.en: When were you made aware of that?
sentences.zh: 你是什么时候知道的？

sentences.en: The U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国

sentences.en: Trade Representative, Jamison Greer, was on the Hill.
sentences.zh: 贸易代表杰米森·格里尔当时正在国会山。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: What are the details?
sentences.zh: 有什么细节吗？

sentences.en: How long is the pause?
sentences.zh: 暂停期有多长？

sentences.en: How many days?
sentences.zh: 多少天？

sentences.en: How many weeks?
sentences.zh: 多少周？

sentences.en: I understand it's 90 days.
sentences.zh: 据我了解是90天。

sentences.en: I haven't spoken to the president since I've been in this year.
sentences.zh: 我今年还没跟总统说过话。

sentences.en: So the trade representative hasn't spoken to the president of the United States.
sentences.zh: 所以贸易代表还没跟美国总统谈过。

sentences.en: He didn't know about it before it happened.
sentences.zh: 他在事情发生前并不知情。

sentences.en: Right, and that earned him some serious mockery from Democrats who said, who is in charge here?
sentences.zh: 没错，这让他遭到了民主党人的严厉嘲讽，他们质问：到底谁在负责？

sentences.en: The legitimacy of his rule of the Communist Party rests on him being able to stand up to the United States.
sentences.zh: 他们达成的任何协议都需要保全面子。

sentences.en: So it really feels like you have two leaders of two of the world's largest economic powers who both feel like they need to project power.
sentences.zh: 从试图缓和局势并达成对双方都有利的协议的角度来看，这一切似乎是一个糟糕的组合。

sentences.en: They cannot back down.
sentences.zh: 所以我很好奇，大卫，他们在这里能做什么？

sentences.en: They cannot capitulate.
sentences.zh: 所以中国当然还有其他杠杆可以利用，给美国造成一些痛苦。

sentences.en: Any deal that they strike would need to save face.
sentences.zh: 仍然有许多大型美国公司在中国市场投资。

sentences.en: And all of that seems like sort of a bad combination from the standpoint of trying to de-escalate and strike some kind of a deal that's productive for both sides.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这是美国企业几十年来一直垂涎的东西。

sentences.en: So I'm curious, David, what could they do here?
sentences.zh: 他们可以针对这些公司。

sentences.en: So China, of course, still has other levers that it can pull to inflict some pain on the United States.
sentences.zh: 它也可以针对好莱坞。

sentences.en: There are still many big American companies that are invested in the Chinese market.
sentences.zh: （注：此处原文编号至149，已全部翻译）

sentences.en: You know, it's something that American businesses have drooled over for decades.
sentences.zh: （注：此处原文编号至149，已全部翻译）

sentences.en: And they can go after those companies.
sentences.zh: （注：此处原文编号至149，已全部翻译）

sentences.en: It can also go after Hollywood.
sentences.zh: （注：此处原文编号至149，已全部翻译）

sentences.en: It could block more films coming into China.
sentences.zh: 这可能会阻碍更多电影进入中国市场。

sentences.en: It could then also target some of the states that produce agricultural commodities that China imports from the United States.
sentences.zh: 它随后还可能针对美国一些生产中国从美国进口的农产品的州。

sentences.en: Those are generally states that voted heavily for Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 这些州通常是唐纳德·特朗普的票仓。

sentences.en: It could also decide not to allow a sale of TikTok, which has been a front burner issue for President Trump.
sentences.zh: 它还可能决定禁止TikTok的出售，这一直是特朗普总统关注的焦点问题。

sentences.en: Lastly, and this is the most risky of the options, it could also devalue its currency to make its exports more competitive in the global marketplace.
sentences.zh: 最后，也是风险最大的选择，它还可能让货币贬值，以提高其出口产品在全球市场上的竞争力。

sentences.en: The problem with that, though,
sentences.zh: 然而，问题在于，

sentences.en: is it would raise tensions with other countries that are worried about Chinese overcapacity and having too many Chinese cheap goods flood their country.
sentences.zh: 这会加剧与其他国家的紧张关系，因为这些国家担心中国的产能过剩，以及大量廉价的中国商品涌入本国。

sentences.en: If both sides don't reach a deal and this whole thing does keep ratcheting up and escalating in the ways that we've already been seeing, what does that look like,
sentences.zh: 如果双方无法达成协议，而这一切正如我们所见的那样不断升级，那会是什么样子呢？

sentences.en: just practically speaking, for both China and the United States?
sentences.zh: 从实际层面来看，这对中国和美国意味着什么？

sentences.en: Well, from the United States, American consumers are just going to see prices go up.
sentences.zh: 嗯，对美国而言，美国消费者只会看到物价上涨。

sentences.en: They're going to order things from Amazon and be shocked by what they're paying for whatever you're ordering from China, which is a lot of things.
sentences.zh: 他们从亚马逊订购商品时，会对自己从中国订购的任何东西（毕竟有很多东西）的价格感到震惊。

sentences.en: From the Chinese side, this is going to make a bad economic situation even worse.
sentences.zh: 对中国而言，这将使本已糟糕的经济形势雪上加霜。

sentences.en: That means higher unemployment.
sentences.zh: 这意味着更高的失业率。

sentences.en: That means factories going idle.
sentences.zh: 这意味着工厂闲置。

sentences.en: That means goods that are just sitting in warehouses.
sentences.zh: 这意味着商品只能堆积在仓库里。

sentences.en: And not being able to offload it onto other countries.
sentences.zh: 而且无法向其他国家倾销。

sentences.en: But ironically, in the long run, this could actually help China.
sentences.zh: 但讽刺的是，从长远来看，这实际上可能对中国有帮助。

sentences.en: It could actually accelerate the one thing they really, really need, which is to reform their economy away from exports.
sentences.zh: 它实际上可以加速他们真正迫切需要做的一件事，那就是改革经济，摆脱对出口的依赖。

sentences.en: They can't be this one-trick pony.
sentences.zh: 他们不能只靠这一招走天下。

sentences.en: They have to find a way to get more people in China to consume things, kind of like Americans, so that their economy is on a more sustainable footing.
sentences.zh: 他们必须设法让国内更多的人去消费，就像美国人那样，这样他们的经济才能建立在更可持续的基础上。

sentences.en: And the problem is the government knows this, but to make that reform requires painful changes that have been really slow and hard to make so far.
sentences.zh: 问题在于政府也知道这一点，但要进行这种改革需要痛苦的变革，而这些变革迄今为止进展缓慢且困难重重。

sentences.en: This is also interesting because it is so similar to the arguments that Trump has been making.
sentences.zh: 这一点也很有趣，因为它与特朗普一直以来的论调非常相似。

sentences.en: Like, both of these leaders feel like what's happening now could be better for each of their countries in the long term after some short-term pain.
sentences.zh: 比如，这两位领导人都认为，在经历了一些短期的阵痛后，现在发生的事情从长远来看可能对各自的国家更有利。

sentences.en: Short-term pain, long-term gain.
sentences.zh: 短期阵痛，长期收益。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's true, except economists have been telling China that it needs to reform its economy for years,
sentences.zh: 没错，确实如此，但经济学家多年来一直告诉中国需要改革经济，

sentences.en: whereas economists in the United States are very skeptical about President Trump's plan and how it would bring manufacturing back to the United States.
sentences.zh: 而美国的经济学家对特朗普总统的计划以及它将如何把制造业带回美国持非常怀疑的态度。

sentences.en: In the meantime, China would definitely prefer its status quo because then it could work on reforming its economy without facing the pressure of a trade war.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，中国肯定更倾向于维持现状，因为这样它就可以在不面临贸易战压力的情况下致力于经济改革。

sentences.en: David, you've been watching this dynamic between China and the United States for years, and what we've seen in the last few weeks, and obviously in the last 24 hours,
sentences.zh: 大卫，你多年来一直关注着中美之间的这种动态，我们过去几周，显然还有过去24小时内所看到的一切，

sentences.en: represents just a massive disruption to that relationship.
sentences.zh: 代表着这种关系受到了巨大的破坏。

sentences.en: And I'm just curious what you think is the most fundamental shift that all of this represents.
sentences.zh: 我很好奇你认为这一切所代表的最根本的转变是什么。

sentences.en: So right now, we're still in the brinksmanship phase, I think, of the trade war.
sentences.zh: 我认为，目前我们仍处于贸易战的边缘博弈阶段。

sentences.en: There's still some room where they're jockeying for some sort of acceptable solution where both leaders save face.
sentences.zh: 双方仍有一些空间在博弈，试图找到某种让两位领导人都能保住面子的解决方案。

sentences.en: But what this disruption has reminded us is that there's a chance these two largest economies in the world could actually divorce what we call decoupling.
sentences.zh: 但这种破坏提醒我们，这两个世界最大的经济体确实有可能出现我们所说的“脱钩”。

sentences.en: And if that actually happens, we'll speak of it as a sort of before and after times.
sentences.zh: 如果这种情况真的发生，我们将把它称为一个“前”与“后”的时代。

sentences.en: To be sure, we're not there yet, but we're closer than ever before.
sentences.zh: 可以肯定的是，我们还没有走到那一步，但比以往任何时候都更接近了。

sentences.en: And you have to think about the U.S.-China relationship for the last five decades.
sentences.zh: 你必须回顾一下过去五十年的美中关系。

sentences.en: The glue has been business.
sentences.zh: 商业一直是维系这种关系的纽带。

sentences.en: It is the bedrock of almost 50 years of bilateral relations.
sentences.zh: 它是近50年双边关系的基石。

sentences.en: If you take that glue away, then everything is on the table now.
sentences.zh: 如果你拿走了这根纽带，那么现在一切皆有可能。

sentences.en: The two most powerful countries can't get together and talk about all the other problems facing the world today, like climate change, like pandemics, like financial crises.
sentences.zh: 这两个最强大的国家无法坐下来讨论当今世界面临的所有其他问题，比如气候变化、流行病、金融危机。

sentences.en: But it also means they can't get together and talk about things they disagree on because they'll have less reason to.
sentences.zh: 但这同时也意味着，他们无法坐下来讨论存在分歧的问题，因为他们这样做的理由更少了。

sentences.en: Things like the fate of Taiwan, fentanyl and human rights.
sentences.zh: 比如台湾问题、芬太尼和人权问题。

sentences.en: And if China and the U.S.
sentences.zh: 如果中国和美国

sentences.en: aren't talking, if they're not engaging on these big issues, then we're suddenly plunged into a far more dangerous world.
sentences.zh: 不进行对话，不在这些重大问题上进行接触，那么我们就会突然陷入一个危险得多的世界。

sentences.en: David, thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 大卫，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you, Rachel.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，瑞秋。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们稍后回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他消息。

sentences.en: On Wednesday, the House of Representatives passed legislation that would bar federal district judges from issuing nationwide injunctions,
sentences.zh: 周三，众议院通过了一项立法，禁止联邦地区法院法官发布全国性禁令，

sentences.en: the latest attempt by Republicans to undercut judges who have blocked President Trump's agenda.
sentences.zh: 这是共和党人试图削弱那些阻挠特朗普总统议程的法官的最新尝试。

sentences.en: Trump and his allies have been frustrated by how frequently district court judges have struck down his executive orders on issues ranging from deportations to mass firings at federal agencies.
sentences.zh: 特朗普及其盟友对地区法院法官频繁否决其行政命令感到沮丧，这些命令涉及的问题从驱逐出境到联邦机构的大规模裁员不等。

sentences.en: But the bill faces an uphill battle in the Senate, where Democrats and moderate Republicans are expected to oppose it.
sentences.zh: 但该法案在参议院面临严峻挑战，预计民主党人和温和派共和党人会反对它。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Claire Tennesketter, Mary Wilson, Carlos Prieto, and Nina Feldman.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由克莱尔·坦内斯凯特、玛丽·威尔逊、卡洛斯·普列托和妮娜·费尔德曼制作。

sentences.en: It was edited by Maria Brann and Paige Cowan.
sentences.zh: 由玛丽亚·布兰和佩奇·考恩编辑。

sentences.en: Contains original music by Marian Lozano, Alishiba Itou, and Roan Niemisto, and was engineered by Alyssa Moxley.
sentences.zh: 包含玛丽安·洛萨诺、阿里希巴·伊藤和罗恩·尼米斯托的原创音乐，并由艾丽莎·莫克斯利进行工程制作。

sentences.en: Our theme music is by Jim Brunberg and Ben Landsberg of Wonderly.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题音乐由Wonderly的吉姆·布伦伯格和本·兰兹伯格创作。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Bavar.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴瓦尔。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》，我们正在为假期接待客人做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人宾至如归的秘诀。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是需要完全黑暗才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是否会睡到不省人事。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们需要什么样的光线环境？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》应用程序或你喜欢的任何播客平台上找到《Wirecutter秀》。
